newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share market makes further gains by close.
newsitem.headline: NZ share market makes further gains by close.

text.p: * Telecom leads NZ share market higher
* Interest rates and global environment seen positive
* Lack of government not seen a hindrance to market ---------------------------(Nov 1)------------------------------

"The bubble hasn't burst and it keeps ticking on. We have had a Wall Street that has shown a bit of life again so the formula still feels reasonably positive for equities," said SBC Warburg's John Rowley.
Market heavyweight Telecom was again a strong performer, rising four cents to $7.39.
Other leaders were either flat or up one or two cents.
Rowley said if the other leaders caught up with Telecom there could be further "oomph" left in the market.

Lion Nathan ended two cents up at $3.67 after being seven down in the morning. Brokers said the price was not responding to Thursday's result, where there were few positives, but to a lack of sellers.

Fernz Corp rose 30 cents to $5.25. Brokers said there were some takeover rumours flying around but they were highly sceptical. One broker said it was responding to the successful placement of a $150 million debt instrument at 9.8 percent.
Corporate Investments fell three cents to 57 cents on heavy volume of 20 million. In a late reported trade, Chairman Peter Masfen sold the parcel to three institutions.
